sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
The Members Management module is the system for the hotel's loyalty/club membership program — registering members, giving them smart cards, recharging/loading the card, and granting membership facilities (restaurant discount, room discount).

MEMBER FLOW: Create category (Silver/Gold/Platinum) → Register member → Initialize + issue Smart Card → Recharge card → When the member visits the property, bill/pay via card → Reward points accumulate.

rows: Card Initialization, Card Registration, Card Recharge, Card Refund

subsections.title: 2.1 Member Category
subsections.paragraph: Define membership tiers — fees, validity, discounts (room/F&B), reward point earning rate. Each category can have different benefits.

rows: How many reward points per Rs 100?

subsections.title: 2.2 Member Master
subsections.paragraph: Member's record — personal details, membership no., category, validity, family members, photo. The member's available facilities are defined in the facility master.

subsections.title: 3.1 Card Initialization
subsections.paragraph: Register in the new blank cards system – card number/serial. This is the inventory of cards which will be issued.

subsections.title: 3.2 Card Registration (Issue to Member)
subsections.paragraph: Link the card to the member – select the member, assign the card serial. Now the member will be identified with the card and will get discount/points in POS/Front Office.
steps: Activate — live on card member name

subsections.title: 3.3 Card Recharge & Refund
subsections.navPath: Smart Card ▶ Card Recharge / Card Refund
subsections.paragraph: By loading amount on prepaid cards (recharge — cash/UPI received). Member spends from the card – balance is deducted. Membership is canceled to refund remaining balance (from Card Refund screen). Card Refund screen: Balance refund on membership surrender + card deactivate — Refund reason has to be written for audit.

rows: Membership surrender — balance refund + card deactivate
